description: Use this when the user asks to edit, add, remove, reorder, or mark items in an existing Familia checklist/list attachment. This replaces the existing list content; list attachments first if the attachment id is unknown.

attachmentId.description: Familia attachment id for the checklist/list to replace.

items.description: Full replacement checklist/list content. Supports nested subtasks.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by the backend request.

name: familia_update_list_attachment
title: Update list attachment
